Since the refunds match, I can proceed to get the net balance for each unique customer and record the payout. The customers are 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I'll start by getting the net balance for 'acme'.
Next, I will get the net balance for 'birch'.
Finally, I will get the net balance for 'cobalt'.

I have successfully retrieved the net balance for all three customers: acme (41189 cents), birch (31975 cents), and cobalt (9154 cents). Since the refunds matched and I have all the required balances, I will now record the payout for each customer, one payout per customer.
Payout recorded for 'acme'. Now I will record the payout for 'birch'.

All payouts have been successfully recorded for acme, birch, and cobalt. I will now generate the final report.
